i18n_description.en: Transforms one landscape 16:9 screenshot into two experimental flash-cut videos by first generating four style options with GPT Image 2.5, letting the user pick one, then animating the selected still into a 3-second Gemini Omni Flash clip and a 4-second Seedance 2.5 clip.
